newsitem.title: USA: U.S. unwrought palladium imports fell in Jan 1997.
newsitem.headline: U.S. unwrought palladium imports fell in Jan 1997.

text.p: U.S. imports of unwrought or powdered palladium fell to 4,831,967 grams in January 1997, from 16,313,049 gram in December 1996, but were up slightly on the January 1996 total of 4,426,158 grams, according to U.S. Commerce Department.
U.S. unwrought or powdered palladium imports for the 1996 year totalled 124,934,965 grams.

But U.S. imports of palladium in semi-manufactured form rose to 2,586,240 grams in January 1997, from 1,579,263 grams in December 1996, and were also up on the January 1996 level of 623,020 grams, according to the latest U.S. Commerce Department data.
U.S. semi-manufactured palladium imports for the year ended 1996 totalled to 20,970,255 grams.
Palladium demand in the U.S. has been rising as auto-companies move to use palladium, rather than platinum, in car exhaust emisssion control devices.

U.S. imports of unwrought palladium from Switzerland in January were little changed at around 102,522 grams in January, from 110,852 grams in December and were down on the January 1996 figure of 202,217 grams.
Total U.S. imports of unwrought palladium from Switzerland in 1996 were 2,382,868 grams.

U.S. imports of semi-manufactured palladium from Switzerland fell to 636,455 grams in January this year, from 962,076 grams in December last year, but were up on the 98,608 grams imported in January a year ago.
For the 1996 year, U.S. imports of semi-manufactured palladium from Switzerland totalled 2,537,447 grams.

Swiss palladium imports have become an important source of supply due to the disruption to Russian palladium exports to world markets since December. Russia supplies about 60 percent of the world's palladium.

U.S. imports of unwrought or powdered palladium from Russia, the world's largest supplier fell to 237,800 grams in January 1997, from 10,907,279 grams in December 1996, but were up on the January 1996 total of 57,100 grams.
Total U.S. imports of unwrought palladium from Russia for the full 1996 year stood at 69,299,714 grams.
U.S. imports of semi-manufactured palladium from Russia rose to 1,204,781 grams in January 1997, from 397,028 grams in December 1996, and were up on the 201,911 grams imported in January 1996.
Total U.S. imports of semi-manufactured palladium from Russia for the full year 1996 totalled 13,753,074 grams.
Data for U.S. metal imports for February is due later this week.
